reproduction.executionFailureDetail: CUDA out of memory; requested 5.94 GiB with 2.95 GiB free and 11.61 GiB already in use

rootCause.evidence: The V003 patch reached provider execution and replaced the full-grid call, but its 65536-vertex decoder chunk still requested 5.94 GiB on the 16GB T4. The failure is therefore a remaining peak-memory problem in the decoder chunk path, not an access, reference, CUDA-kernel, or CLI-default failure.

fix.application: run_spar3d_candidate.py applies the idempotent patch to the ephemeral provider checkout before execution
changes: Reduce the default decoder chunk from 65536 to 8192 vertices
Run the decoder under FP16 autocast on CUDA and retain float32 mesh inputs
Back off the chunk size by half on CUDA OOM down to a 1024-vertex floor
Record sanitized traceback locations for targeted follow-up diagnostics

nextAction: Keep V005 as the next one-time strategy correction; do not repeat V004 unchanged.
